capabilities: Cap installed community plugins by vault file count
Disable the Browse and Install buttons at the limit
Show slot usage and files until the next slot in settings
Count disabled plugins toward the limit
Flag when installed plugins exceed the allowance
extras: Installation is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/plugins-limitter, or build from source; the README only points to a release page "if available".
motivation: The author wanted to counter "productivity procrastination" — endlessly browsing, installing and configuring plugins instead of thinking and writing — by making more notes the price of another plugin.
problem: Obsidian's plugin ecosystem makes it easy to keep browsing and installing plugins instead of writing, and nothing in the app puts a brake on plugin collecting.
summary: Guardrail that caps installed community plugins at 5 plus one per 10 vault files, disabling the Browse and Install buttons once the limit is reached.
